div.div:
Kafka command checkpoint outcomes
- Signal position not committed: the command can be polled again. A duplicate snapshot request is possible.
- Signal position committed but no Connect snapshot context: the signal consumer resumes after the command. An external retrigger can be required.
- Neither outcome proves whether snapshot rows were published.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 528px; height: 1px; padding-top: 950px; margin-left: 53px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Recovery limits
- SQL CDC retention must still contain the committed LSN.
- Losing connect-offsets or schema history is a different recovery incident.
- SQL Server schema changes are unsupported during an incremental snapshot.
- Normal resume is documented design, not yet container-proven by #68.
